description: Search HM Land Registry Price Paid Data by town, county, and/or local authority district (at least one required) — e.g. town="WARRINGTON" or county="GREATER LONDON". Optional filters: min/max price paid (GBP), min/max transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD), and pagination. Returns the same per-sale fields as search_by_postcode. Data: HM Land Registry, no auth required, Open Government Licence v3.0.

county.description: County to search (e.g. "GREATER LONDON"). At least one of town, county, district is required.

district.description: Local authority district to search (e.g. "WARRINGTON"). At least one of town, county, district is required.

max_date.description: Only include transactions completed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

min_date.description: Only include transactions completed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

page_size.description: Number of transactions per page (1-100, default 20).

town.description: Town/post town to search (e.g. "WARRINGTON"). At least one of town, county, district is required.

name: uk-landregistry-pricepaid.property.by_area

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UK Property Sales By Area
